PHYSICAL OBJECTS AND STATES
STATES OF CONSCIOUSNESS

1. Inorganic: Matter and Energy of Cosmos
Subjective Knowledge

Philosophical, Theological, Scientific, Historical, Literary, Artistic, Technological
